rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for aerobics as a choreographed fitness exercise, especially when done to music.

example.english: I go do aerobics every Saturday.
example.traditional: 我每個星期六都去跳健美操。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 go3 sing1 kei4 luk6 dou1 heoi3 tiu3 gin6 mei5 cou1

rows.note: Use this when focusing on the cardiovascular or aerobic-exercise aspect rather than the music-and-routines format.

example.english: Running is my favorite form of aerobics.
example.traditional: 跑步係我最鍾意嘅帶氧運動。
example.jyutping: paau2 bou6 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 ge3 daai3 joeng5 wan6 dung6
